title: Deception_data
description: This dataset comprises EEG, physiological (ECG, respiration, EDA, EMG), and behavioural data collected in 2020 from 44 healthy adults (ages 21-40) during resting-state and task-based conditions. Tasks included a spontaneous deception paradigm (a gambling game requiring participants to report predictions truthfully or deceptively) and a cognitive control battery assessing processing speed, response selection, response inhibition, and conflict resolution. The dataset supports research into the neurophysiological correlates of deception and cognitive control processes.
methods_description: EEG signals were recorded using the TruScan 128 Research EEG system with electrodes placed according to the standard 10-5 system, sampled at 3000Hz, with impedance kept below 20 kOhm. Ground electrode was placed on the zygomatic bone and reference electrodes on the mastoids; channels 124 and 125 recorded vertical EOG. Physiological signals (ECG, RSP, EDA, EMG) were recorded at 4000Hz using the BioPac MP160 system and AcqKnowledge 5.0 software, with ECG collected via a modified Lead II configuration, RSP via a respiration belt, EDA via finger electrodes, and EMG via corrugator muscle activity.
